name: HuNote
description: Server-stored notes for email messages via IMAP headers.
author: Pavel Alexeev

open-note-editor.description: Open HuNote editor for selected message

_comment_messagesModify: Required so message_display_scripts (reader.js) inject into message frames. TB overrides matchesWindowGlobal in ext-mail.js:76-82: for MESSAGE_PROTOCOLS scheme (imap/mailbox/news/nntp/mid) content scripts run only if extension has 'messagesModify' OR ('messagesRead' + 'scripting'). MatchPattern doesn't accept imap:// scheme so host_permissions can't grant this. Without it: ExtensionError 'Missing host permission for the tab' at ExtensionUtils.sys.mjs:46.
